title: coleus herbaceus
intro: Coleus herbaceus, commonly known as Coleus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Coleus herbaceus include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Coleus herbaceus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
